description: Completion: the agent distinguishes verified from partial work, marks DONE only with executed checks, and records residual risk.

scenarios.context: The agent completed the implementation but has not run tests or verified the output. The user asks 'is it done?'

criteria.description: The agent must distinguish verified (tests pass, checks run) from partial (implementation complete, not verified).
The agent must not mark DONE without executed checks.
The agent should record residual risk (untested paths, unverified assumptions).

scenarios.expectation: The agent distinguishes verified (tests pass, checks run) from partial work and reports the residual risk and pending checks explicitly.

scenarios.context: The agent ran tests and they passed. The agent must mark DONE with evidence of the executed checks.

criteria.description: The agent must mark DONE with evidence of executed checks (test output, command run).
The agent must not claim success without evidence.

scenarios.expectation: DONE is held until every required check is executed and its observable output is recorded; assertions without executed checks are rejected.
